newsitem.title: TUNISIA: FORECAST-Tunisia sees 7.5-8 pct 1996 GDP growth.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Tunisia sees 7.5-8 pct 1996 GDP growth.

text.p: Tunisia's gross domestic product (GDP) is expected to reach 7.5 to eight percent in 1996, from a budget forecast of 6.7 percent, Economic Development Minister Taoufik Baccar said on Tuesday.
He told journalists that based on a 2.5 million tonnes cereals crop estimate, the GDP will grow by 7.5 percent, and by up to eight percent if the cereals crop is higher.
GDP rate was 3.3 percent at constant prices in 1994.
